text: Good morning, Earthling! Rise and shine!
Good morning! Eat your breakfast. Brush your teeth.
New day, new words! Let us learn one today.
Hello, Earthling! The plural of 'cactus' is 'cacti'.
One cat, two cats. One box, two boxes!
A baby cat is a kitten. A baby dog is a puppy.
It's raining cats and dogs! (It means raining very hard.)
A hot dog is not a dog. It is food. Funny!
In 'queue' you say the first letter only. Q!
She sells seashells by the seashore.
Say it fast: red lorry, yellow lorry!
The word 'set' has many meanings. More than 400!
'Big' and 'small' are opposites. So are 'hot' and 'cold'.
'In' and 'out' are opposites. So are 'up' and 'down'.
'Cat' and 'hat' sound the same at the end.
Say it three times: 'I am', 'you are', 'he is'.
Ask a question! Use 'what', 'who', or 'where'.
I like pizza. Do you like pizza? Say 'Yes, I do'.
Mix red and yellow. You get orange!
The rainbow has seven colors. Name three of them!
Point to something red. Now something blue!
A week has seven days. Today is one of them!
Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday... say the rest!
One year has twelve months. My year has 400 days!
What is 2 + 2? Use your fingers. That is fine.
You have ten fingers. Count them. Am I right?
Wave your left hand. No, the other left one!
A caterpillar becomes a butterfly. Wow!
Cows say moo. Ducks say quack. What do you say?
An elephant is very big. An ant is very small.
A giraffe has a long neck. It eats high leaves.
Spiders have eight legs. They are not insects.
A dog has four legs. A bird has two. I have six!
Penguins are birds. But they swim. They do not fly!
Many fish together are a school. But no homework!
Fish live in water. They are never thirsty.
Owls sleep in the day. They wake up at night!
A sloth sleeps a lot. Sixteen hours every day!
Bees make honey. Say thank you to a bee!
Trees drink water with their roots. Deep down!
The sun is a star. It is our close star.
Stars are big suns. They are very, very far away.
The moon has no light. The sun lends it some.
Earth has one moon. Jupiter has many. I lost count!
Ice is cold. Fire is hot. Soup is warm.
Water can be ice. Ice can be water. Magic!
Your heart works all day. It never stops!
Please and thank you are magic words. Use them!
Wash your hands before you eat. Soap and water!
Drink some water, Earthling. Your body likes it.
Tidy one thing now. Only one. It helps!
Stand up! Jump ten times. One, two, three...
Name three animals. Fast! I will wait.
Sing a song. Loud or quiet. Both are good.
Draw a green alien with six legs. Draw me!
Tell a joke to someone. Make them laugh!
Read a book today. Ten minutes is enough.
Say hello to three people today. It is easy!
Today is a good day to be kind. Every day is!
Big smile, Earthling! A smile costs nothing.
A cat sleeps all day. What a good plan!
Good night, Earthling! Sleep tight!
The sun is down. The moon is up. Time to rest.
Good evening! What was the best part of your day?
